stops.title: Discounts get a minimum total
stops.body: A discount now carries the smallest total it applies to. Below that, the customer pays the full price.

stops.title: Every discounted total passes the new check
stops.body: Checkout and new orders now skip the discount on small totals. `Discount` gains a `minimumCents` field, and `applyDiscount` checks it before taking anything off, so every caller of `applyDiscount` picks up the rule. `totalOf` is rewritten with `reduce`; it gives the same totals.

stops.title: Small totals keep their full price
stops.body: `applyDiscount` returns the total untouched when it is under `discount.minimumCents`. The welcome promo sets its minimum to 2000 cents.

stops.title: `totalOf` sums with reduce
stops.body: The loop becomes one `reduce` over the items, starting from 0, so an empty cart still totals 0.

stops.title: A test for a total under the minimum
stops.body: The test discount gets a 500-cent minimum, and a new assertion checks that 400 cents stays 400.

stops.title: Your verdict
stops.body: Discounts now stop below a minimum total, for every caller. Is that the behavior you want?
